digest.component_or_area: DC rich-text live harness and inbound echo-suppression
propositions: Live DC harness must assert rendered HTML via ?expand=renderedFields (bold/*foo*→<b>, heading/h1.→<h1>, code/{code}→<pre>) to prove codec fidelity against Jira's real renderer, not just wiki source

State-based echo-safety requires a second reconcile pass against converged baseline to produce zero inbound mutations (landed rich body re-reads as unchanged) when local and remote encode the same content via their respective wire formats

Both-sides concurrent edit conflict requires rebar's local edit + Jira's remote edit before next pass to keep local body, record remote value, and emit deduped outbound-field-conflict:<key>:description alert (not silent clobber or Jira-wins)
normalize_rich_text contract test must pin the public shape and behavior of InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text across repos to fail breaking changes before agentic-dev-platform import breaks

Inbound differ must inject the neutral OutboundMapper port and use codec-aware echo-suppression (_description_forms/_text_matches) to treat Jira's value as unchanged when it matches the local body's landed wire form, mirroring outbound's _baseline_form_matches

DC rich-text cutover must be enabled (REBAR_RECONCILER_RICH_TEXT_CUTOVER=dc) during live test push to exercise Markdown→wiki codec conversion (WikiTextCodec.to_wire) so rendered HTML assertions prove end-to-end fidelity
